name: One Love ~Yoru no Boku wa Ecchi na Onee-chan no Omocha ni Naru~
original_name: おね恋 ～夜のぼくはエッチな従姉のおもちゃになる～
source:
Yuu has just started his sophomore year but his cousin, Rin, suddenly comes to his school to work as a trainee teacher. Since they haven't seen each other for a long time and Rin has become quite beautiful, he starts to see her as a woman. However, she still treats him like a younger brother.

One day, he accidently picks up Rin's underwear and is discoverd by her. Surprisingly, she tells him that she would help him. And so, his erotic life guided by her begins.

translation:
优刚升入高二，表亲凛突然来到他的学校，担任实习教师。两人久未见面，凛也变得十分漂亮，优开始把她当成女人看待。然而，凛仍然把他当弟弟对待。
